model.name: Boyle & Cohen 2008 C. elegans body-wall muscle cell (SingleCompMuscleCell)
model.citation: Boyle JH, Cohen N (2008). Caenorhabditis elegans body wall muscles are simple actuators. Biosystems 94(1-2):170-181. doi:10.1016/j.biosystems.2008.05.025
model.expected_behavior: Single segment (d 10 um, L 230 um), no Na channel: Leak 0.0193 (erev +10 mV), k_slow 0.436, k_fast 0.400, ca_boyle 0.220 mS/cm2 (Ca-carried spikes) and a fixedFactorConcentrationModel Ca pool. Harness: -120 pA holding for the whole run plus +0.23 nA 10-200 ms. Shipped reference for the jNeuroML OMV test (.test.m.mep, threshold -10 mV): 1 spike at 37.6 ms. NeuroML-DB (NMLCL001548) reports a resting potential of -27.9 mV without holding current. Not simulated in this sweep.
model.inclusion_reason: MIT; jNeuroML OMV test; distinct channel composition (Ca-based excitability, no Na). Caveats: a muscle cell, not a neuron; the depolarised rest means protocols need a holding current; CaPool.nml notes say "Not appropriate for muscle model? Needs replacing!"; the shipped harness produces a single event; no GitHub check-runs recorded at this commit.
